name: Collecting Dominoes
description: Collecting Dominoes is a western domino game where play emphasizes accumulating advantageous outcomes over a hand sequence while still operating through legal matching placements on a shared layout.

overview.description: Collecting Dominoes is a western domino game where play emphasizes accumulating advantageous outcomes over a hand sequence while still operating through legal matching placements on a shared layout.

history.origins: The rules are encountered as a modern western domino format emphasizing collection-style scoring goals expressed through standard matching play.
timeline: Modern era: circulated through social play and rules references.
history.cultural: Played as a casual scoring-focused variant that remains approachable to new domino players.
history.evolution: Collection-style goals are layered on top of standard matching legality.

setup.dealing: Deal tiles by player count; remaining tiles may be boneyard by local rule.
setup.equipment: Domino set and score tracking for collection-style scoring.

rules.objective: Score best under the table's collection goal while attempting to shed tiles efficiently.
rules.gameplay: Players place legal matching tiles to open ends. Collection scoring is applied based on the table's defined collected outcomes during play or at hand end. The hand ends when a player goes out or play blocks.
keyRules: All placements must be legal matches to open ends of the shared layout.
Collection scoring is applied by table rule profile to define what is collected and when.
Hand ends on first empty hand or complete block resolution.

strategy.basic: Avoid wasting flexible tiles unless they contribute to the collection goal.
strategy.intermediate: Track what has already been collected to plan the remaining value routes.
strategy.advanced: Shape end values to force opponents away from profitable collection outcomes.
tips: Do not sacrifice hand flexibility just to chase marginal collection points.
When ahead, prioritize safe shedding lines to avoid late blocks.

synthesis.shortDescription: Collecting Dominoes is a connecting domino game on a double-6 set with a collection-oriented scoring goal layered on standard matching play.
